Name: Befriend the Crows
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Science has compared crows to be of equal intelligence as a 5 to 7 year old child. So instead of fighting them and having an antagonistic relationship with them, why not put in the work to befriend them and see what happens?!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

• A new buildable structure from Robin. The Crow Feeder. Use this to leave offerings to the crows.
          ﻿- There is no in game indicator for befriending the crows, but you'll know. Crow rewards start small, like less likely to eat your crops. But eventually, they may start bringing you presents back in return!
• Ignore the crows too long, and they may forget how much they like you....
• Easy setup for modders to add / change compatibilty with other mods' crops or add new skins / themes (see notes below)

The Crow feeder is a 2x2 building that takes 1 day to build and can be purchased from Robin for 1,000g, 50 wood, 2 iron bars, and 1 fire quartz.

You can feed the crows once per day. 

Here are the rewards and tiers as they currently stand
[spoiler]

Loved gift - 25 friendship points
Liked gift - 12 Friendship points
Neutral gift - 5 friendship points


Loved Gifts: Corn, Pearl, Prismatic Shard, Emerald
Liked Gifts: Coal, Wood, Stone, Fire Quartz, Copper Ore, Diamond
Neutral Gifts: Mixed Seeds

Crow rewards:
0 Hearts: 0% chance of no crows
1 Hearts: 10%  chance of no crows
2 Hearts: 30%  chance of no crows
3 Hearts: 50%  chance of no crows
4 Hearts: 75%  chance of no crows
5 Hearts: 100% chance of no crows
6+ hearts the crows will remain gone and will start bringing gifts

Gifts can be the current or lower tier. The more hearts the wider the gift pool

6 Hearts: Trash
7 Hearts: Seasonal Wild Seeds
8 Hearts: Diamond
9 Hearts: Prismatic Shard
10 Hearts: A random trinket
[/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

There are no known conflicts, currently only Vanilla crops and seeds are accepted by the crows.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]

[list]
[*]There are too many different themes and crops for me to account for all of them at release, so I have made it easy for modders to customize or add-in what they want.[/*]
[/list]To add food / seeds for the crows:

Example
[spoiler]
{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Mods/Huskyn1nja.KindredCrows/Diet",
      "Entries": {
        "Loved": [ "CustomItem_ShinyPebble" ],
        "Liked": [ "CustomItem_SlightlyLessShinyPebble" ]
      }
    }
  ]
}[/spoiler]

To add items that the crows can leave as rewards (note that "MinPoints" is the minimum number of friendship points needed for that item to be in the loot pool:

[spoiler]
{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Mods/Huskyn1nja.KindredCrows/Loot",
      "Entries": {
        "MyDrop1": {
          "ItemId": "MyCoolThing",
          "MinPoints": 2000
        },
        "MyDrop2": {
          "ItemId": "MyCoolThing2",
          "MinPoints": 1500
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}[/spoiler]
Lastly, to add custom themes / skins to Kindred Crows (since people love themselves an aesthetic)

[spoiler]
{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Huskyn1nja.KindredCrows/Themes",
      "Entries": {
        "Gothic": "Mods/<mod id>/SpookyFeeder"
      }
    }
  ]
}[/spoiler]
I have now made the code open source and available on my Mod github [url=https://github.com/Huskyn1nja/StardewValleyMods]Here[/url]
